title: Citrus+
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A sequel to the yuri series Citrus. High school stepsisters Yuzu and Mei, whose rivalry turned to romance in the first series, are now dating openly, and friends and family keep offering unwanted advice as the two try to work their relationship out themselves (Seven Seas blurb; Wikipedia article on Citrus for background).
life_message: Two people who love each other should be free to define their relationship on their own terms.

content.note: Same-sex romance between stepsisters (AniList Yuri 96%; MU Stepsibling Love, False Incest). The original series drew criticism for non-consensual advances (Wikipedia reception); how far Citrus+ continues this is to verify.
Dress-code defiance and fashion (Wikipedia, AniList Fashion); relationship dynamics from the first series.
